Definition: {a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people}
BiblicalUsage: Kacday is a Chaldaean — the people of the land Nebuchadnezzar ruled. Ezra's enemies remind the king that the God of heaven gave Israel into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the Chaldaean, who destroyed the house and carried the people away.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that empires rise and fall at God's word, and the Chaldaeans who carried Judah away were themselves only instruments in His hand.
